# V1 population of the 59 Unsupported Confident Findings (SYNTHETIC)
These are NOT customer cases. They are 14 synthetic sellers of the V1 500-seller stress run (engine c3baa5a, harness efa0fc1, seed 0; run fingerprint rows sha256 9f268f4d7fc1...). The fixtures hold only the two files a seller would load (Amazon VAT invoice report, accounting export) and their declarations. Generator metadata (the harness's hidden truth) is NOT included on purpose.
ids59.json lists the 59 Amazon transactions (transaction id, order id, shipping id) that the V1 engine reported as confident BOOKS_GAP/ACTION_REQUIRED. Reproduce the dumps: tools/audit-v1.sh. The files carry sha256 values that the test pins.
Description used for them: Unsupported Confident Findings. They are findings the file could not support (is-amazon-invoiced TRUE together with invoice-status InvoiceUploaded in the same row). They do not prove that Amazon issued those invoices.
